page: Microsoft Azure DC4ads_v6 is a general-purpose confidential compute instance powered by AMD EPYC 9V74 processors. The instance provides 4 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped across 2 physical cores with multithreading enabled on the x86_64 architecture. Memory capacity is configured at 16 GB of RAM, adhering to a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Hardware capabilities include 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a 32 MB L3 cache slice, along with instruction set extensions such as AVX-512 (F, VNNI, and BF16), AES, and SHA_NI for cryptographic operations.

Storage consists of an integrated 161 GB local solid-state drive, accompanied by support for Premium Storage remote volumes. The server does not include dedicated graphics processing units. Synthetic evaluation indicates competitive single-threaded CPU execution, evidenced by a top-quartile stress-ng single-core score of 3021.36 and an average Geekbench single-core score of 1890.0. Cryptographic throughput and memory subsystem speeds register in the mid-range based on PassMark encryption and memory results.

The constrained core footprint reflects clear scaling boundaries in parallelized computation. Multi-core metrics across stress-ng (6011.14) and Geekbench (4178.0) place the server in lower performance brackets, with corresponding weak scores in parallel compilation, ray tracing, and PassMark database operations. Redis SET throughput reaches 5.28 million operations per second.

The DC4ads_v6 delivers a balanced compute-to-memory profile suitable for entry-tier enterprise workloads requiring hardware-level security features and fast local scratch storage. Its resource envelope fits small web applications, microservices, secure enclave testing, and light CI/CD task runners where overall parallel compute demand remains modest.
description: Microsoft Azure DC4ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine featuring 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores on an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it delivers 16 GB of memory and includes a 161 GB local SSD for high-speed temporary storage. The processor incorporates vector and cryptographic extensions, including AVX-512 and AES instructions. In benchmark evaluations, the DC4ads_v6 demonstrates solid single-threaded performance with top-quartile stress-ng single-core results and mid-tier PassMark CPU and memory marks. However, multi-core throughput across Geekbench, compiling, and database tests reflects the inherent limitations of its four virtual cores. Lacking dedicated GPUs, the instance represents an efficient configuration for basic application hosting, small transactional databases, confidential computing tasks, and standard business logic operations.
